routing_warnings.description: The message claims adjustment of middle-section image alignment, not implementation of the black-background block-separation treatment.
The reported mobile overflow concerns responsive pricing-panel containment, not the required panel count or desktop side-space layout.
This message reiterates the mobile containment failure and belongs to the narrower responsive-containment Requirement.
The message claims that the duplicate page is available but does not state or demonstrate that its pricing section was removed.
The second point reports excessive spacing between the primary and secondary controls and belongs to the placement-and-spacing Requirement.
The third point requires the control or its text to link to a lower section and belongs to the navigation Requirement.
The question about using a button or linked text concerns section-jump behavior and leaves the implementation mechanism open; it does not clearly change the no-wrapper visual treatment.
Point 1 requires adding the missing secondary control to the first section and belongs to the coverage Requirement.
Point 2 requires reducing the gap and placing the controls directly beneath one another, which belongs to the placement and spacing Requirement.
This failure concerns direct YouTube-button visibility in the mobile navigation path, not desktop placement.
This implementation claim explicitly concerns the YouTube icon's mobile placement.
